---
title: "Class 14. Optional demo: animate Rosling with gganimate"
format: html
---

Teacher demo. If the install fails on your computer, watch the teacher's screen.

```{r}
#| label: setup
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, gganimate, gifski, here)
```

```{r}
#| label: animate
#| eval: false
# One frame per year. transition_time() interpolates between years.
here("data", "rosling_tidy.csv") |>
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = income, y = life_exp, size = population, color = continent)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 15) +
  labs(title = "Year: {frame_time}", x = "Income per person", y = "Life expectancy") +
  theme_minimal() +
  transition_time(year)   # printing the plot renders the animation
```
